description: Apply a live GLOBAL transposition (semitones) on top of any per-channel transposition. The validator (JsonValidator.validateByCommand → playback.schemas.js) requires `semitones` to be an integer in [-48, 48] before the handler runs. The handler calls `midiPlayer.setGlobalTranspose()` — a non-destructive performance offset applied at scheduling time (0 clears) — and echoes the truncated value. This is NOT a file rewrite (that path is MidiAdaptationService.transposeChannels, used at assignment time).

cases.name: nominal — transpose up 3 semitones echoes the value
